The lessee is also liable for damages to persons and property resulting from the mining operations. Cancellation and forfeiture of the lease for violation of the terms and conditions of the lease is an additional lease stipulation.
Supervision of the Mining and Reclamation Plan
The leased premises and mining operation are subject to inspection by an authorized representative of the Secretary of Interior. The Area Mining Supervisor, U. S. Geological Survey, is the designated representative of the Secretary of Interior. In this capacity he must review the mining operation and ascertain adherence to the mining plan. After such review, the mining plan may be modified with additional mitigating stipulations.
Interior Department regulations govern the Bureau of Indian Affairs and U. S. Geological Survey supervision and administration of mined areas relative to surface management operations and reclamation. These are included in 25 CFR 177, Surface Exploration, Mining, and Reclamation.
